study_protocol.purpose: Windows execution, cross-platform implementation control and a first N32/N64 resolution comparison. No physical-accuracy certification.

physics.profile: Preserved open-trailing-edge NACA0012 contours in base_project.json

default_study.termination: fixed time only; no wall time limit or steady-flow stop
default_study.thread_selection: min(8, available logical CPUs), frozen in PLAN.json

linux_n32_reference.source: Completed same-code N32/downstream6 CPU2 reference; not wind-tunnel measurements

experiment.comparison: Preserved digitized measurements at Re30000, interpolated to alpha4; no parameter fitting
experiment.limits: Marker bounds are not full tunnel uncertainty. Transition, turbulence, trailing-edge geometry and periodic span are not certified equivalent.

study_protocol.interpretation: Report means/RMS/drift and differences between two grids. Do not infer Richardson/GCI/order, DNS, statistical convergence, high-Re readiness or validated Cl/Cd/Cm from two cases.
study_protocol.return_archive: CSV, JSON, logs, SVG and last section frame only; full checkpoints and compiler cache stay local.
